verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, so I picked A only by a hair. Both have the same flaws: the flavour chips are scattered in a staggered layout off the grid (Blood Orange is offset from the two right-hand chips), the Shop Flavours button is off-centre and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge, the legal line is tiny, and the bottom third is mostly empty apart from a cropped circle. B moves the button, chips and legal text up, which jams the button against the subhead and leaves even more empty space at the bottom. A keeps slightly better spacing between those elements.
